Definition: to prolong, i.e. (reflex) be deformed by excess of members
BiblicalUsage: Sara' is what sticks out wrong — a limb grown too long, a body deformed by excess. The priest with any such blemish could not approach to offer, and Isaiah pictures a bed too short to stretch on, with a covering too narrow to wrap in.
TheologicalSignificance: I take this as a plain warning that what is out of measure cannot cover me, and only what God appoints fits.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
